$comment: Every moderate/high advisory reported by `npm audit` must be fixed or listed here. Critical advisories cannot be excepted. Each entry is re-reviewed before `expires`; the gate fails on expiry. Scope meanings: build-tool = runs only on the build/CI machine against repository-controlled inputs and is verified absent from shipped bundles; dev-tool = test/dev tooling only; runtime-unreachable = ships in an artifact but the vulnerable function is not called (evidence required). Withdrawn advisories are removed, not kept as exceptions.

exceptions.artifact: none shipped; Metro reads image dimensions of repository assets at bundle time
exceptions.justification: Infinite-loop DoS on crafted JXL/HEIF/ICNS files. Only repository assets are parsed; the app never parses images with this library at runtime.
exceptions.evidence: Re-checked 2026-10-26. Patched release is image-size >= 2.0.3 (latest 2.0.4). imageSize() in 2.0.4 accepts only Uint8Array; file paths moved to the separate image-size/fromFile export. metro@0.83.3 Assets.js getAssetData() still calls imageSize() with a filesystem path string for ordinary assets (node_modules/metro/src/Assets.js line 173) and with a Buffer only for the .zip/ case. An override would break asset bundling. Absent from Android/iOS bundle source maps (gate-checked in CI).
exceptions.remediation: Expo SDK upgrade that moves Metro onto image-size >= 2.0.3 and the fromFile API.

exceptions.artifact: none shipped; Expo CLI manifest code signing
exceptions.justification: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw. Used by Expo CLI only for expo-updates manifest code signing; this app does not install expo-updates and app.json configures no codeSigningCertificate, so no signature is verified with node-forge in any build or at runtime.
exceptions.evidence: Re-checked 2026-10-26. npm view node-forge version is still 1.4.0; no patched release. apps/mobile/app.json and app.config.ts set no updates.codeSigningCertificate. expo-updates is not a dependency of apps/mobile. Absent from bundle source maps (gate-checked in CI).
exceptions.remediation: Re-evaluate before enabling expo-updates/code signing; Expo SDK upgrade.

exceptions.artifact: Android and iOS JS bundles (query-string/index.js and decode-uri-component/index.js are bundled)
exceptions.justification: Exponential decoding DoS on malformed percent-encoded input. In query-string 7.1.3 decodeComponent is reached only through parse/parseUrl/extract. A repository-wide search of installed JavaScript finds query-string required only by expo-router, and those call sites only stringify.
exceptions.evidence: Re-checked 2026-10-26 against expo-router 6.0.24. stringify is called at build/fork/getPathFromState.js:276 and getPathFromState-forks.js:71. The parse call in getStateFromPath.js:538 is still commented out, and that file does not require query-string. No other installed package requires query-string. Upgrading query-string to 9.x remains unsafe: 9.x is ESM default-export only, so expo-router's __importStar(require('query-string')).stringify would be undefined at runtime. stringify output parity between 7.1.3 and 9.5.1 was confirmed earlier; the interop break makes an override incorrect.
exceptions.remediation: expo-router >= 58 (npm audit fix target expo-router 58.0.26), which is an Expo SDK major upgrade.
